title: Rajasthan Weather: Barmer Records 38.2°C in November as Temperatures Stay Above Normal - Sangri Today
full_text:
Heatwave in Rajasthan still going on even in November. The day temperature in various cities in the state was two to five degrees Celsius higher than normal. The maximum temperature in Barmer city was 38 degrees Celsius. This is the second time in ten years that the temperature in Barmer city has gone to this much in the month of November.
There are a number of cities where heat is prevailing because of intense sunlight. Increase in night temperatures has made day morning and evening temperature uncomfortable.
The reason behind such kind of change in weather conditions is the formation of an anti-cyclone in the southwest part of Rajasthan. This has weakened the effect of northern winds and increased the effect of western winds. This has resulted in the formation of clear sky and bright sunlight throughout the day, causing increase in temperatures.
The impact of this weather change is particularly visible in western Rajasthan. In the early days of November, daytime temperatures in many districts, including Barmer, have remained well above normal. This is the second time in the last ten years that such heat has been observed in western Rajasthan in November.
Both day and night temperatures are remaining above normal. Minimum temperatures in Barmer, Pali, Jaisalmer, Bikaner, Sriganganagar, and Churu are being recorded three to five degrees Celsius above normal.
On Sunday, Mount Abu experienced the coldest night in the state. The minimum temperature here was 12.1 degrees Celsius, which is about four degrees above normal. This clearly indicates that even the mountainous regions of the state are not experiencing the expected cold.
According to the Meteorological Center, Jaipur, the weather is expected to remain clear in the state for the next week. Cloudy skies or rain are unlikely during this time. Bright sunshine during the day may also cause a slight increase in maximum temperatures in some cities.
